name: Safi
sourceReview: ANCFCC is the evidenced national cadastral custodian, and its official directory lists a Safi cadastral office. This is custodian/procedure evidence only. The Safi-Youssoufia Urban Agency atlas is an official planning atlas, not an open parcel service. No safe anonymous parcel geometry or stable native parcel identity was verified.

requestOutcomes: ANCFCC root, cadastre, and cadastral-plan pages returned HTTP 403 to direct anonymous GETs; no bypass was attempted. Official discovery provided the ANCFCC mandate, Safi office directory, and service-flow evidence. The official AUSY atlas page returned HTTP 200 and its Safi province PDF was downloaded and inspected; it contains planning/territorial material, not parcel geometry. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe field request was used.

The AUSY atlas is planning/territorial context and does not provide safe parcel features.
HTTP 403 and the absence of a parcel layer in the inspected atlas are not evidence of parcel absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, legal-description, or value fields were requested or retained.
